name: AKAI APC40 mkII
notes: AKAI APC40 mkII, Generic Mode (Mode 0). Verified against the official Akai 'APC40 Mk2 Communications Protocol' (v1.2, 2015) and the manufacturer layout art. The 5x8 clip grid has RGB pads on notes 0-39 addressed by NOTE NUMBER (not channel): note 0 = PAD 1 = TOP-left, incrementing left->right then downward, note 39 = bottom-right. LED colour is a 128-entry velocity palette (5=red, 13=yellow, 21=green #00FF00, 45=blue, 122=Green, 120=Red, 124=Yellow); the MIDI channel of an LED message picks the RGB behaviour (channel 0 = Primary Colour solid). Scene Launch buttons are RGB too. Track button rows (Record Arm 0x30, Solo 0x31, Activator 0x32, Track Select 0x33, Clip Stop 0x34, Crossfader-A|B 0x42) use MIDI channel 0-7 = Track 1-8 (stored as channel 1-8). Bank (Bank Lock) = note 0x67. The Cue Level (CC 0x2F) and Tempo (CC 0x0D) knobs are RELATIVE encoders using the Akai signed scheme (1-63=+, 64-127=-, 0x7F=-1), decoded via encoding.mode 'signed' (PAM-20). The 8 DEVICE CONTROL knobs (CC 16-23) are BANKED by Track Selection (they transmit on the selected track's channel; bound at channel 1 = the Track-1 power-on default). TRACK SELECT (0x33) and MASTER (0x50) send no MIDI in Generic Mode. Transport: Play=0x5B, Record=0x5D, Session Record=0x66 (no dedicated Stop); UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/SHIFT/TAP/NUDGE have no host LED.
